content.text: {"headline":"The spreadsheet has 7 names and 5 working emails, all at least 231 days old.","verdict":"Hand it over as a stale 7-row artifact with 5 usable emails, not as a current member list.","claim":"You can truthfully transfer 7 unique rows with no empty cells and no duplicate emails, but only 5 of those emails are usable and the newest joined date is 231 days old.","risk":"The recipient may treat 7 names as active members, email 2 malformed addresses, and plan around a list whose newest joined date is 231 days old.","steps":["Fix or remove the 2 malformed values in \"email\" before anyone sends or quotes counts.","Rebuild the capture flow; the newest \"joined\" date is 231 days old.","Hand over only the 5 contactable rows until the capture flow is rebuilt."],"priority":[{"check":"Emails are deliverable-shaped","why":"Handing over bad email values makes the list unusable for contact."},{"check":"Recently active","why":"The newest dated entry is 231 days old, so the handoff is stale."}]}
